changelog: Fix: sidebar nav is now independently scrollable on short viewports (768px/600px) — it was previously cut off with no way to reach the lower items
Fix: dashboard/stats Win Rate and Avg R no longer count Open trades in their denominator/average; a caption now discloses the active-challenge scope and any excluded open trades
Fix: the same closed-trades-only rule applied to the by-session/fib/pair/direction breakdown win% columns, for one consistent convention across the Statistics page
Fix: CalculatorController's calculate_risk endpoint now requires a direction and rejects a stop/target on the wrong side of entry instead of silently computing a plausible-looking R
Fix: trades.session no longer silently defaults to London when omitted — the column is now nullable with no default, and the trade form and Excel import both leave it unset rather than guessing
No retroactive changes to existing session values — we cannot know which historical London trades were genuine
